title: Fann Wong and Christopher Lee spotted receiving volunteer award at son's school, Entertainment News

 entertainment Fann Wong and Christopher Lee spotted receiving volunteer award at son's school
 Fann Wong and Christopher Lee were each spotted receiving a token of appreciation at Maha Bodhi School for being parent volunteers. PHOTO: Xiaohongshu/Xiaohongshu_2468 PUBLISHED ON November 19, 2026 2:01 PM BY Yeo Shu Hui Fann Wong and Christopher Lee were each spotted receiving an award for being parent volunteers at Maha Bodhi School, where their son Zed is enrolled.
 A Xiaohongshu netizen posted on Thursday (Nov 19): "Documenting my daughter's primary one awards ceremony and spotting celebrities...
 "My child attends the same school as the celebrities' child. Fann keeps herself looking so good and Christopher is very charming."
 She also included two photos of the celebrity couple — who married in 2009 — receiving tokens of appreciation from the school's principal See Lai Kwan.
 On the school's website, Fann is listed as one of the support group's Exco members.
 PHOTO: Xiaohongshu/Xiaohongshu_2468 Fann had previously shared about her participation in her son's school activities.
 In 2025, the 55-year-old actress posted two photos of herself posing with a few posters used as decorations for Teachers' Day designed by her.
 She wrote in the caption of her post then: "Switching to parent mode. Off to school with Zed and the four 'teachers' that I designed!"
 PHOTO: Xiaohongshu/Fann Wong In early November, Fann also shared an Instagram post of a collection of 3D-printed figures that she and 12-year-old Zed made for his school's charity jumble sale.
 She wrote in the now-removed post: "Good luck son! I hope everyone will like what we've made and pass on the kindness."
